## Starting QBs

- **Fix applied:** games.csv sometimes lists the QB who played most rather than the one who started (e.g. Week 17 rest games). The model now uses the QB on each team's first dropback (players listed at QB only): **88 team-games corrected**. Before the fix nflverse and nfelo disagreed on 76 games; the line below is after it.
- **nflverse vs nfelo starter:** 5,552 games compared; disagreements: **17** (0.3%).
  Examples: 2006_02_OAK_BAL: nflverse Andrew Walter / Steve McNair, nfelo Aaron Brooks / Steve McNair; 2009_11_SEA_MIN: nflverse Seneca Wallace / Brett Favre, nfelo Matt Hasselbeck / Brett Favre; 2013_03_OAK_DEN: nflverse Matt Flynn / Peyton Manning, nfelo Terrelle Pryor / Peyton Manning; 2013_09_PHI_OAK: nflverse Nick Foles / Matt McGloin, nfelo Nick Foles / Terrelle Pryor; 2015_01_IND_BUF: nflverse Andrew Luck / Tyrod Taylor, nfelo Andrew Luck / Matt Cassel; 2018_14_NYJ_BUF: nflverse Josh McCown / Josh Allen, nfelo Sam Darnold / Josh Allen
- **Listed starter vs the QB with most dropbacks (play-by-play):** 11,104 team-games; different in **323** (2.9%). In 316 of these the listed starter had under half the dropbacks: these are mostly starters who left injured or were benched mid-game (used in round 4 as the "QB left the game" signal), not data errors.
